expectations.text: Player experience sections describe specific game moments
expectations.evidence: All 5 玩家体验 sections reference concrete game elements: 方案一 mentions specific items (西瓜, 柠檬, 苹果, 芒果), specific pools (水果池), and rarity (稀有苹果); 方案二 names specific affixes (波动的, 稀碎的), rarity (传说品质), and a specific affix mechanic (以旧换新); 方案三 describes '全水果订单', '精准抽取', '交互型词缀'; 方案四 names a specific item (注射器) from a specific pool (药物池) with a specific affix (波动的) and tool (命运熔炉); 方案五 references specific pool types (药物类订单, 电器订单), rarity progression (Common→Uncommon), and the candidate selection mechanic. None use abstract platitudes like 'players make interesting choices.'

expectations.text: Proposals reference actual game systems accurately
expectations.evidence: 系统交互 sections accurately reference real systems from game_rules.md: (1) 5 item pools (correct count per rules), (2) 3 active draw pools with affixes (correct), (3) specific affix names that exist in game_rules.md (波动的/volatile, 稀碎的/fragmented, 提纯的/purified, 精准的/precise, 以旧换新的/trade-in), (4) inventory/merge system with correct merge rules (same name + same rarity), (5) order system with 2 candidate generation on completion (correct per rules: '为每个完成的订单生成2个候选订单供选择'), (6) emergency orders as separate system (correct: 急单不给积分), (7) tool items (命运熔炉/reforge correctly described), (8) rarity tiers correctly referenced (Common, Uncommon, Rare, etc.), (9) recycle mechanics. No factual errors about game systems detected.

Scope signals explicitly range across ambition levels. 方案五 is marked '小' (small scope) and described as '最保守的方案——改动最小，风险最低' with minimal changes only to order candidate generation logic. 方案三 is marked '中等偏大' (medium-large scope) requiring a ripple event content system, extensive text design, and new UI notifications. The comparison table confirms the range: Scope values are 中小, 中, 中大, 中, 小. The summary reinforces this: '方案五最保守、最快验证；方案三叙事空间最大但成本也最高.'

expectations.text: Avoids known dead-end patterns from setting doc
expectations.evidence: Checked all 5 proposals against all 11 dead-end categories in setting-current-state.md. None require unexplained world logic (all layer onto existing systems); none change the player character (all change world conditions/environment); none require major gameplay changes (all explicitly preserve core 抽取→库存→提交 loop, e.g. 方案一: '三个奖池、词缀、订单、背包、合成全部保留'); none make uncertainty a player choice (uncertainty remains forced); none introduce fantasy elements; none use time pressure as substitute for irreversibility; none make the same loop numerically harder as punishment (方案五's escalating demands come with escalating rewards); none reduce theme to management efficiency; none contradict the established framework (company as social mirror, character treats this as normal work, uncertainty as basic condition); none propose mystery answers.
